The decisive mistake was made by ImageProcessing_Expert at step 0. The OCR output was not reliably read and the fraction list was never properly extracted from it. The expert hardcoded an incomplete and partly wrong fraction list: `[(3,4),(1,4),(2,4),(5,35),(1,21),(30,5)]`. This list dropped fractions that appear in the text, such as the repeated 3/4s, 1/2 and 7/21. It misread 7/21 as 1/21. It also left out the sample-problem fractions and their answers (1/15, 1/3, 4/9, 1/8, 32/23, 103/170). Every later agent used this flawed list, so the final output could not match the correct answer.

AGENT: ImageProcessing_Expert
STEP: 0
